papers.title: Compilation-Regime Geometry
papers.current_ceiling: The frozen n≤3 separator has k*=4; transfer to unseen n=4 failed, and the proposed capacity invariant is true but vacuous.
post_matrix_updates: The size-transfer-invariant package is now on main and explicitly stops promotion because the tested invariant does not explain transfer.
load_bearing_adverse: The four-feature law fails on unseen n=4.
The capacity condition is satisfied by all frozen representations and is therefore non-discriminating/vacuous.
The manuscript abstract is stale relative to the enlarged-vocabulary adverse result.
papers.strongest_remaining_gap: A non-vacuous invariant must explain separator complexity and make a prospective prediction on n=5 without reusing the failed four-feature law.
papers.decisive_question: Is minimum compilation-regime separation exactly the transversal number of the opposite-label collision hypergraph derived from n≤4, and does that invariant predict the frozen n=5 separator before any n=5 cost measurement?
papers.maximum_claim_if_supported: A combinatorial law for regime-separator complexity that explains the n=4 failure and predicts new sizes without post hoc feature growth.
papers.hypothesis_or_theorem: For a frozen candidate vocabulary, construct a hyperedge for every opposite-label pair that collides unless at least one distinguishing interaction is selected; prove that the minimum separating representation equals the hypergraph transversal number, then derive a deterministic n=5 prediction from n≤4 only.
papers.population_or_universe: All regime-labelled objects at n≤4 for derivation and the prospectively generated complete n=5 challenge for confirmation.
papers.unit_of_analysis: An opposite-label object pair, distinguishing interaction and complete size-n universe.
historical_only_inputs: All n≤4 outcomes and the failed four-feature separator are derivation data only
design: Repair the manuscript to report the n=4 adverse result and vacuous invariant before any successor work.
Define the canonical interaction vocabulary and hypergraph construction using n≤4 only.
Freeze n=5 generation, expected k*, witness family and exact checker before any n=5 cost or label analysis.
Use an implementation-independent enumerator and mutation controls.
primary_endpoints: Equality of predicted and observed n=5 witness family.
negative_controls: Representation with high capacity but an opposite-label collision.
Feature duplication that raises capacity without changing fibres.
Synthetic hypergraph with known transversal number.
analysis_plan: n=5 is a one-shot prospective confirmation and all mismatches are adverse.
No metric or feature may be added after n=5 outcomes.
papers.power_or_exhaustion_rule: Exhaust n≤4 derivation and the complete frozen n=5 universe; any timeout is CANNOT_CHECK.
papers.success_gate: The equivalence is machine-checked and the n=5 k*/witness prediction is exact under the frozen vocabulary.
papers.refutation_gate: A counterexample to the equivalence or any n=5 prediction mismatch falsifies the transfer law and should be published as the boundary.
papers.cannot_check_gate: CANNOT_CHECK if the interaction vocabulary, labels, universe generator or checker changes after n=5 is available.
papers.authority_required: Independent exact enumerator plus proof checking; primary-source novelty review across feature selection, test covers and hypergraph transversals.

active_lane.collision_rule: New identity only; the size-transfer-invariant lane is closed adverse and cannot be patched.

immediate_safe_actions: Update the bounded manuscript with the n=4 failure and vacuity result.
Generate n=5 metadata without computing labels or separator costs.
forbidden_actions: Do not rescue the four-feature separator.
Do not use capacity as explanatory when it is constant across all candidates.
Do not inspect n=5 outcomes before the prediction is bound.
papers.journal_bar: A top-tier theory/learning paper needs a non-vacuous invariant, proof, true holdout prediction, full negative history and exact reproducibility.
papers.sibling_boundary: Owns representation-separator geometry; general typed-state value belongs to ORION-08.
